# chip-nyc

Plant list for Chip (https://chip.family). Licensed NYC kitchens from DOHMH inspections. Not a live menu. Nothing is Open.

## Fetch

- One ZIP: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4d-Studio/chip-nyc/main/zips/11372.json
- City: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4d-Studio/chip-nyc/main/nyc.json
- ZIP index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/4d-Studio/chip-nyc/main/index.json
- Browse: https://4d-studio.github.io/chip-nyc/

Each kitchen: id, name, street, zip, boro, cuisine, bag, lat, lng.

bag=yes can plate. maybe = coffee/donuts/bakery. Do not scrape DoorDash, Uber, Grubhub, or Yelp.

Source: NYC DOHMH dataset 43nn-pn8j.
